transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Since the V-12 vision-inspection station commissioning is scheduled for this weekend, I'd like to get our pre-work review started. Before I approve the work order, I need to check in with maintenance, quality, and safety. We also need to finalize whether the station goes at Cell 3 or Cell 7 — both produce the same product family, so I'd like to hear from each of you on which location makes the most sense and any concerns you have before we proceed.

transcript.text: I need to share some important findings from my fit-up check on the V-12. The camera mount aligns only with Cell 7's 6 mm bracket pattern — it won't fit Cell 3. Installing at Cell 7 requires exactly 4 hours and isolation of exactly 3 electrical points. I recorded all the measurements in the weekend commissioning file, but it's still awaiting engineering signoff and hasn't been added to the work-order summary yet, so this information may not be in front of you.
